in

Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Akshay Joshi, learned counsel for the 
petitioner.
2. Mr. Rajeev Singh Bisht, learned Additional 
C.S.C. along with Mr. V.S. Rawat, learned Brief 
Holder for the State of Uttarakhand/respondent no.1.
3. Mr. Bhupendra Singh Bisht, learned counsel for 
the respondent nos.2 & 3. 
4. An Impleadment application has been moved by 
the petitioner for impleading Uttar Pradesh Jal Nigam
through its Managing Director, Lucknow, as 
respondent no.4 in the writ petition.
5. Since, the impleadment sought is made for 
impleading the necessary party in the writ petition;
therefore, there is no serious objection from the side of 
the respondents.
6. In this view of the matter, the said impleadment 
application (IA/2/2023) is allowed.
7. Let the necessary impleadment be incorporated 
within three days by filing the amendment memo of 
parties as per Rule.
8. List on 26.02.2024 as fresh.
 
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.) 
 20.02.2024

COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPSS No.2088 of 2023
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Akshay Joshi, learned counsel for the 
petitioner.
2. Mr. Bhupendra Koranga, learned Brief 
Holder for the State.
3. Mr. Bhupendra Singh Bisht, learned 
counsel for respondent nos.2 & 3.
4. Petitioner has filed this writ petition 
seeking the indulgence of this Court for a 
direction to the respondents including U.P. Jal 
Nigam to make payment of G.P.F. amount from 
the year 1973 to 1976. Petitioner retired from 
service in the year 2010.
5. Learned counsel for the respondent(s) 
prays for and is granted six weeks’ time to file 
counter affidavit(s).
6. Thereafter, two weeks’ time is granted to 
the petitioner to file rejoinder affidavit.
7. Issue notice to the respondent no.4-U.P. 
Jal Nigam, returnable within six weeks.
8. List on 15.05.2024.
9. Meanwhile, respondent no.4 may also file 
its counter affidavit. 
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 26.02.2024
AK
